text:
Jules: Heads-up — over the last 18h we've had ~14 GPU OOM pages across rtx-pool-2, but 11 of them were single-request spikes and resolved within 1min. Proposing we stop paging on raw instantaneous OOMs and shift to a smoothed + grouping policy. Thoughts? @oncall :thinking:

Priya: +1. We should differentiate transient KV-cache spikes from sustained memory pressure. Proposal: keep current alert but change paging condition to a 3m avg + burst suppression, and make the slack route go to ticketing if it clears within 5m.

Tom: Agreed. Practically we can: bump the paging threshold to 95% for instant pages, add a `for: 3m` on the sustained rule, and use `increase()`/`avg_over_time()` to detect trend not noise. Example alert rule snippet: 
```
- alert: GPU_Memory_SustainedHigh
  expr: avg_over_time(gpu_memory_used_bytes{pool="rtx-pool-2"}[3m]) / gpu_memory_total_bytes > 0.9
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
This will let quick blips pass to ticketing instead of paging.

Marta: Also want to tune grouping/muting in Alertmanager: set `group_interval: 10m` for gpu routes and add a `repeat_interval` fallback. For planned maintenance we should have a metric-marker and a routing mute window so ops work doesn't hit pages. Example route snippet: 
```yaml
route:
  receiver: "sre-team"
  group_by: ["pool"]
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 10m
  repeat_interval: 4h
  routes:
    - match:
        severity: "page"
      receiver: "pagerduty"
```

Priya: We should also surface the change in Grafana — add a small panel showing "page vs ticket" counts and a p95 time-to-resolve so we can confirm we aren't hiding regressions. Add a regression alert that triggers if pages drop but p95 latency for succesful requests rises.

OncallBot: incidentbot: New quieter routing config proposed by Jules. Test rollout scheduled in staging at 2024-09-12T02:00Z.

Jules: OK action items: 1) Priya to author PR for Prometheus rules (staging only), 2) Tom to add Alertmanager route & group settings, 3) Marta to add Grafana panel + SLO check. We'll run a 30m chaos test on staging to validate. If green, roll to prod Monday morning. :thumbsup:

Tom: I'll keep thresholds conservative in prod patch, move fast on the alertmanager changes so we can observe for 48h before changing paging policy prod-side.

Marta: I'll add an annotation on the dashboard with the rollout time and a quick runbook link for oncall.

Jules: Thanks all — filing ticket to track (SRE-4962).
